The formula combines Panthenol (Vitamin B5), Madecassoside (from Centella Asiatica), and La Roche-Posay's Tribioma complex - a prebiotic and probiotic blend that supports skin microbiome balance. Shea butter and mineral-derived occlusives seal everything in. It goes on face, body, and lips. The texture is rich - this is a balm, not a lightweight moisturizer - but it spreads easily and does not leave a greasy film once absorbed. Avoid the eye contour area. La Roche-Posay is a French dermocosmetic brand. Made in France. Does not contain added fragrance. Featured in dermatologist recommendations by Dr. Aanchal Panth (for very dry skin and eczema) and Dr. Nirupama (for sensitive skin) on Nykaa. Suitable for all skin types. Unisex. Can be used day and night. What This Product Does Repairs the skin barrier: Panthenol supports epidermal recovery and helps reduce transepidermal water loss. Madecassoside (derived from Centella Asiatica) calms inflammation. Together they help skin that has been compromised by actives, shaving, waxing, sun exposure, or dermatological procedures. Supports microbiome balance: The Tribioma complex includes Vitreoscilla Ferment and Lactobacillus - probiotic-derived ingredients that help maintain healthy skin flora. This matters if your skin is exposed to pollution, sweat, or frequent cleansing. Locks in moisture: Shea butter and hydrogenated polyisobutene form a breathable occlusive layer. Glycerin pulls water in. The combination keeps skin hydrated in AC environments and through dry winters. Soothes irritation: Zinc Gluconate and Manganese Gluconate help calm redness and minor irritation. Useful after retinol use, chemical peels, or laser treatments. Works in Indian conditions: The balm holds up in humid coastal cities like Mumbai when applied as a thin layer, while still providing enough occlusion for AC-dried skin or dry northern winters. What This Product Does NOT Do No SPF - you still need sunscreen. Will not brighten or lighten skin. Not an acne treatment - it calms irritation but does not treat active breakouts. Not a lightweight gel - it is a repair balm with a rich texture. Does not contain exfoliating acids. Who Should Use It Sensitive or reactive skin that flares up easily Dry to very dry skin dealing with flaking, tightness, or rough patches Post-procedure skin - after peels, lasers, microneedling, or dermat treatments Anyone using actives (retinol, AHAs, BHAs) who needs a recovery balm People in high-pollution cities or AC environments for long hours Anyone looking for a single balm that works on face, body, and lips All skin types, including skin prone to irritation Who Should Skip It If you want a lightweight gel for peak summer humidity - this is a balm with weight to it Extremely oily skin types who prefer matte-finish moisturizers Anyone with a known sensitivity to shea butter, dimethicone, or occlusive formulations If you need targeted treatment for pigmentation, acne, or anti-aging - this is a repair balm, not a treatment How to Use Apply generously on face, body, and lips twice daily on pre-washed, dried skin. Avoid the eye contour area. How much to use: A pea-sized amount for targeted spots or a coin-sized amount for the full face. Adjust quantity for body areas. Morning routine: After cleanser and any serums, before sunscreen. Night routine: Last step after all treatments. Avoid applying too thick a layer in humid weather - a thin layer absorbs better and will not feel heavy. Do not use it in place of sunscreen - it contains no SPF. Do not apply near the eye contour area - not recommended by the brand. Do not expect it to treat active acne. Avoid over-layering before sunscreen - too much product can cause pilling. product_name: Plum 2% Niacinamide & Rice Water Moisturiser - Lightweight Gel Cream For Oil-Free Hydration
description: About This Product Engineered for India's high humidity and pollution-heavy environments, the Plum 2% Niacinamide & Rice Water Moisturiser is a lightweight gel cream designed to deliver oil-free hydration while regulating sebum production. Powered by 2% Niacinamide, a clinically studied form of Vitamin B3, this formula helps improve skin barrier function, reduce excess oil, and refine the appearance of pores over time. This is a fragrance-free, daily-use facial moisturiser with a fast-absorbing, non-sticky gel texture. While it is particularly well-suited for oily and acne-prone skin, it is catalogued for all skin types, making it a versatile pick for anyone seeking lightweight hydration without heaviness. Suitable for both men and women, it works in AM and PM routines without interfering with sunscreen or makeup layers. The formula also features Squalane for lightweight moisture-locking and Opuntia Ficus-Indica (Prickly Pear) Stem Water for soothing hydration, alongside a biotechnologically derived Pseudoalteromonas Ferment Extract for skin conditioning. What This Product Does Balances Oil Production: 2% Niacinamide helps regulate sebum activity, making it suitable for oily and acne-prone skin common in Indian climates. Provides Lightweight, Oil-Free Hydration: The gel cream format hydrates without heaviness - critical for humid weather conditions. Squalane contributes non-greasy moisture-locking. Strengthens Skin Barrier: Niacinamide supports ceramide synthesis, helping skin retain moisture despite AC exposure or pollution. Improves Skin Texture: Regular use may reduce the appearance of enlarged pores and uneven texture. Soothes and Brightens: Rice water extract (Oryza Sativa) and prickly pear stem water contribute mild soothing and skin-conditioning benefits, promoting a healthier-looking, brighter complexion. Day and Night Use: Suitable as a moisturising step in both morning and evening routines. What This Product Does Not Do Does not provide instant whitening or fairness. Does not replace treatment for active acne (not a medicated product). Does not deliver heavy occlusive hydration (not designed for very dry skin needing rich creams). Does not contain SPF or offer sun protection - always follow with a dedicated sunscreen in the morning. Does not contain fragrance (it is fragrance-free). Who Should Use It Oily skin types seeking oil-free hydration. All skin types looking for a lightweight, fragrance-free gel moisturiser. Combination skin that needs balanced moisture without heaviness. Acne-prone skin needing non-comedogenic hydration. Individuals living in humid, tropical climates. Those dealing with enlarged pores, dullness, or uneven texture. Beginners looking to introduce niacinamide into their routine. Both men and women (unisex formulation). Who Should Skip It Very dry or severely compromised skin needing rich occlusive barriers - this gel cream is lightweight by design. Individuals with known sensitivity to niacinamide or any ingredient in the INCI list - patch-test first. Those looking for active acne treatment with prescription-grade ingredients - consult a dermatologist for medicated products. Anyone seeking SPF protection from their moisturiser - this product does not contain sunscreen filters. Common Questions Can this moisturiser be used in peak Indian summers? Yes. Its lightweight gel cream texture is specifically suited for hot and humid climates. It absorbs quickly and does not leave a greasy residue. Will it cause sweating or stickiness? No. It is formulated as a non-greasy, fast-absorbing gel cream. The fragrance-free formula also avoids additional sensitising ingredients. Can I use it with other niacinamide serums? Yes, but layering may increase the total niacinamide concentration on your skin. Monitor for any signs of irritation and adjust usage if needed. Is it safe during pregnancy? Niacinamide is generally considered safe for topical use, but consult a healthcare professional for personalised advice.
ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Pseudoalteromonas Ferment Extract, Niacinamide, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Extract, Caprylyl Methicone, PEG-12 Dimethicone/PPG-20 Crosspolymer, Triolein, Opuntia Ficus-Indica (Prickly Pear) Stem Water, Squalane, Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer, Ethoxydiglycol, Cyclopentasiloxane, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Disodium EDTA
key_ingredients: 2% Niacinamide: Refines the pores and improves skin texture. Rice water: Hydrates the skin and enhances brightness. Pseudoalteromonas ferment extract: Helps to soothe and repair the skin barrier. Opuntia ficus-indica (prickly pear) stem water: Provides antioxidant benefits and hydration. Squalane: Moisturizes and helps maintain skin’s natural barrier.
how_to_use: Cleanse your face and pat dry. Take a sufficient amount of the gel cream and apply evenly on your face in slow upward and outward circular motions. Massage gently to ensure absorption and hydration. Do not forget to apply on the neck area.

product_name: Cetaphil Moisturising Cream Restores Damaged Skin Barrier In 1 Week
description: About This Product A dermatologist-trusted classic for deep, barrier-focused hydration. Cetaphil Moisturising Cream is a rich emollient cream designed to restore and protect the skin barrier while delivering sustained hydration. Classified as a dermacosmetic, it is formulated with a blend of emollients and humectants - including glycerin, refined almond oil, and dimethicone - that help reduce moisture loss and improve skin softness over time. Its non-irritating, fragrance-free, and paraben-free formula works by reinforcing the lipid barrier, making it especially suitable for compromised, dry, sensitive, or dull skin conditions. The product is also cruelty-free and vegan. This cream can be used on both face and body, offering a thick, nourishing texture that absorbs without leaving a heavy residue. Suitable for all age groups and genders, it performs well in environments with AC exposure, harsh winters, or pollution-heavy urban settings. What This Product Does Restores Skin Barrier Function: Helps replenish lost lipids using emollients like refined almond oil and light liquid paraffin, improving the skin's natural defence against environmental aggressors. Provides Long-Lasting Hydration: An occlusive-plus-humectant system (glycerin, dimethicone, light liquid paraffin) reduces transepidermal water loss (TEWL). Soothes Dryness and Irritation: Suitable for sensitive skin prone to tightness, flaking, or redness. Supports Dull Skin Recovery: Catalogued for concerns including dull skin alongside dryness and sensitivity, helping restore a healthier-looking complexion with consistent use. Multi-Zone Hydration: Effective for both face and body, especially dry areas like elbows, knees, and hands. Climate Adaptive: Performs well in dry AC environments and mild winter conditions, where skin dehydration is common in India. Antioxidant Support: Contains Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E) and ALL-RAC-Alpha Tocopherol, which help protect skin from oxidative stress. What This Product Does Not Do Does not provide instant fairness or brightening effects. Does not contain active exfoliants (AHAs, BHAs, or retinoids). Does not offer sun protection (no SPF). Does not contain fragrance (it is fragrance-free, not merely fragrance-minimal). May not feel lightweight enough for very oily skin in humid climates. Who Should Use It Dry to very dry skin types. Sensitive or irritation-prone skin. Dull skin lacking radiance due to environmental stress. Individuals exposed to AC environments for long hours. All age groups, including those seeking a simple, dermacosmetic-grade moisturiser. Who Should Skip It Very oily or acne-prone skin in humid weather - the cream's rich texture may feel heavy. Those with known sensitivity to any specific ingredient listed in the INCI (e.g., cetyl alcohol, benzyl alcohol, or PEG derivatives). Users looking for active-based treatments such as anti-ageing, acne control, or chemical exfoliation. Common Questions Is Cetaphil Moisturising Cream safe for sensitive skin? Yes. product_name: Dot & Key Vitamin C + E Super Bright Gel Moisturizer For Face, Visibly Boosts Glow

Now, when it comes to taking care of your pores and giving your skin a good exfoliation, it all starts with ingredients straight from the good ol' earth - red beans and kaolin. Kaolin in the Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask is like a superhero when it comes to sucking up excess sebum.
